subject: Reserved commit buckets & staged onramp — bridging plan for HelixAI
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Mehra <sanjay@helixai.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Reserved commit buckets & staged onramp — initial proposal

Hi Sanjay,

Great talking earlier — thanks for walking me through HelixAI's Q2/3 inference profile. Per our call, attached is a compact proposal that gives three reserved-commit structures plus an optional staged onramp (fractional capacity) you asked about. High-level summary:

- Option A — 12 months: baseline reserve = 8 A100-equivalent GPU pool; 10% on-call burst; standard SLA (99.5% uptime), 8% discount off list.
- Option B — 24 months: baseline reserve = 12 A100-equivalent GPUs; 15% burst; improved p95 latency guarantee under committed throughput; 14% discount.
- Option C — 36 months: baseline reserve = 16 A100-equivalent GPUs; 20% burst; throughput guardrails + fallback model variant; 22% discount + onboarding credit.

Staged onramp (fractional start): we can open with 30–50% of the baseline reserve for the first 30–60 days, with deterministic ramp milestones at day 30 / day 60 / day 90. Pricing and credits are adjusted pro rata during the staging window.

Throughput guarantee (example): commit guarantees 2.5K concurrent short requests (avg 128 tokens) with p95 latency under 600ms for the primary model; we’ll put explicit token-rate caps per model so we can enforce predictable economics.

What I need from you to firm this up:
- Confirm desired commit length (12/24/36) and preferred baseline GPU count.
- Any must-have SLA targets beyond p95 latency (e.g., p99).
- Whether you need the fractional onramp (30/50/75%) and target start date (we penciled in Jun 28).

I've attached ReservCommit_Tiers_HelixAI_v1.pdf with the pricing tables and a sample SOW for the staged onramp. If this looks good, I’ll run the 36-month deep-discount option by Marcus for approval on the onboarding credit.

Available for a quick sync Mon/Tue next week to finalize numbers.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0182

Attachment: ReservCommit_Tiers_HelixAI_v1.pdf (pricing table, SOW)
From: Sanjay Mehra <sanjay@helixai.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: HelixAI Procurement <procurement@helixai.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Reserved commit buckets & staged onramp — initial proposal

Thanks Vanessa — appreciate the fast turnaround. A few follow-ups from our side before we loop procurement: 

1) Fractional capacity: we like the idea of starting at 40% then stepping to 75% by week 6. Can you show worked examples of billing during the fraction? We need predictable month-over-month invoicing.
2) Flexibility: can unused capacity be reallocated across models (multi-model routing) or is it strictly pool-level? Helix runs three production models and we'd like to shift capacity between them without renegotiation.
3) Credits & start date: our preferred start is Jul 12 (6 weeks). If that's later than your standard provisioning window, what bridging credit do you offer?
4) Discounting: 22% for 36 months looks attractive — any room to move to ~26% if we commit to a 24/7 premium SLA and longer payment terms?

Procurement copied here — they'll want an explicit DocuSign link and a clean SOW for the staged onramp. Once we see a final T&Cs + DocuSign, Procurement will run approval.

Regards,
Sanjay Mehra
VP Product, HelixAI
sanjay@helixai.com

Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Reserved commit buckets & staged onramp — initial proposal

Sanjay — quick responses inline and a tightened proposal attached (v2).

1) Billing during fractional start: we’ll bill the committed baseline at the fractional rate for the staging window. Example (Option C baseline = 16 GPUs): start at 40% (6.4 GPUs billed at 40% list price) month 1; at day 31 we bill 70% if you step to 70%, etc. We’ll include monthly line-items showing baseline, fractional factor, and any burst usage billed separately. (See sheet Bridge_Onramp_SOW.xlsx)

2) Flex reallocation: yes — pool-level capacity can be routed across models. We’ll include a multi-model routing policy in the SOW; non-disruptive shifts up to a configured percentage are supported without renegotiation.

3) Bridging credit if start > 14 days beyond the mutually agreed provisioning date: we propose a one-time credit equal to 7 days of baseline fees for delays >14 days, and 14 days credit for delays >30 days.

4) Discounting / SLA trade: I’ve outlined two concession paths in the v2 PDF: 1) standard payment terms + 22% (36m) or 2) extended payment term (net 60) + 26% (36m) but that requires a 24/7 premium SLA addendum (surcharge baked into unit economics). I’ll need Marcus to greenlight the 26% path and the onboarding credit.

Next steps: I’ll loop Marcus to confirm margin for the enhanced discount + onboarding credit. If Marcus signs off, I’ll push a redlined term sheet and the DocuSign packet to Procurement.

Regards,
Vanessa

Attachment: ReservCommit_Tiers_HelixAI_v2.pdf; Bridge_Onramp_SOW.xlsx
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sanjay Mehra <sanjay@helixai.com>, HelixAI Procurement <procurement@helixai.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Reserved commit buckets & staged onramp — initial proposal

Looping in — approved in principle for the 36-month enhanced package with concessions below: 

- Approve one-time onboarding credit equal to 4 weeks of baseline fees for Option C (16 GPUs) if Helix signs 36 months.
- Approve 26% list discount for 36 months only if Helix accepts the premium SLA (24/7, 4-hour incident response, higher uptime target).
- Approve the described bridging credit (7/14 days) for provisioning delays.

Conditions: Legal needs an explicit SLA addendum (we require a fallback model policy and a mitigation path if throughput exceeds committed levels for sustained periods). Finance will accept net 60 for the 26% discount, otherwise standard net 30.

Operational ask: recommend we set a 60-day ramp milestone plan for the staged start: Day 0 = 40% capacity; Day 15 = 70%; Day 30 = 90%; Day 60 = 100%. If Helix requires a longer tail, we’ll include a phased scaling schedule in the SOW.

Vanessa — please push v2 redlines + the DocuSign packet to Procurement once you confirm the payment term choice.

Marcus Lin
Head of Sales — Dedicated, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai
